title: My Morning
text:
I wake up at seven o'clock. First I drink a glass of water. Then I make coffee and open the window. The air is cold in the morning, but I like it.

My cat comes to the kitchen. She is hungry every morning. I give her food and she is happy. After that I take a shower and get dressed.

I leave home at eight. The bus stop is near my house. I wait five minutes and the bus comes. I look at the city from the window. This is my normal morning.

title: A Small Shop
text:
There is a small shop near my house. The shop is old. The man in the shop is old too. His name is Peter and he works there every day.

I buy bread, milk and apples there. The bread is warm in the morning. Peter always says hello and asks about my family.

The big supermarket is cheaper, but I like the small shop. It is quiet and I know the man. Sometimes small things are better than big things.

title: Weekend at Home
text:
I do not work on Saturday. I sleep until nine and this is very good. Then I cook eggs and read the news on my phone.

In the afternoon I clean my room. I do not like cleaning, but I like a clean room. This is a problem for many people, I think.

In the evening my friend comes. We watch a film and eat pizza. We talk about work and about our plans. Saturday is short but it is my favorite day.
